title: Cell value from a configuration
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input string, let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$, and let $s,j$ be natural numbers. The cell value at position $j$ has an optional head descriptor: it is present when $j=0$ and then records the machine state together with the three-valued summary of the output tape; otherwise it is absent. For each work tape, it records the symbol at position $j-s$ and whether that tape's head is at position $j-s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with $k$ work tapes
